overview.title: Overview
overview.whatIsLede: Mataresit takes the manual data entry out of receipt and expense management. Upload a photo or PDF, and AI reads the merchant, date, totals and line items, categorises the spend and hands you a clean ledger — accurate enough to file, editable enough to trust.

features.title: Automated data extraction
features.description: Upload JPEG, PNG or PDF; the system pulls merchant, date, total and line items on its own.

features.title: AI-powered enhancement
features.description: Merchant names are normalised, payment methods standardised and categories predicted — with suggested fixes for OCR slips.

features.title: Confidence scoring
features.description: Every extracted field carries a confidence score, so you see at a glance what's safe and what needs a second look.

features.title: Real-time processing
features.description: A status timeline follows each receipt from upload to completion — no guessing what the queue is doing.

features.title: Semantic search
features.description: Ask in plain language: "coffee from last week" or "what did I buy at Watsons?" finds the line item.

features.title: Batch processing
features.description: Drop a stack of receipts at once; they process in parallel with full control over the queue.

features.title: Analysis & reporting
features.description: Spending dashboards plus PDF reports summarised by category or payer, ready for the accountant.

features.title: Flexible AI models
features.description: Choose between AI Vision and OCR+AI pipelines to balance speed, cost and accuracy per upload.

steps.description: After signing in, you land on your main workspace — the receipts inbox.

coreFeatures.title: Core features
coreFeatures.batchBody: Batch upload processes many receipts in parallel, with controls to start, pause and retry failed items — built for the shoebox months. Free plans queue 5 files at a time, Pro 50, Max 100.
coreFeatures.confidenceBody: When the AI suspects an OCR error it offers a one-click correction. Every key field also shows a confidence bar:
coreFeatures.confidenceNote: Editing a field manually sets its confidence to 100%.
coreFeatures.visionBody: AI Vision hands the raw image straight to the model — no intermediate text extraction. It copes better with complex layouts, handwriting and multiple languages, which covers most Malaysian receipt formats from mamak stalls to hardware suppliers.
coreFeatures.searchBody: Ask for what you remember, in the words you'd use out loud:

items.question: Why is my receipt stuck or failed?
items.answer: The processing status on the card or viewer shows the current stage. A failed_ai stage usually means a low-quality image. Reprocess the receipt, or enter the data manually — both are one click from the receipt viewer.

items.question: Why are my search results not what I expected?
items.answer: Semantic search relies on embeddings. Receipts uploaded before the feature was enabled may not have them yet — admins can generate embeddings for the back catalogue from Admin → Settings.

items.question: How do I change my subscription?
items.answer: Manage the subscription, view invoices and update payment methods from the Stripe billing portal. Open it via any plan card on the pricing page, or the payment-success screen after a transaction.

items.definition: A processing method where the AI model reads the image directly to extract and understand its contents.
A numerical representation of text that captures semantic meaning — the engine behind AI search.
Search that interprets intent and context rather than matching exact keywords.
A per-field probability that the extracted value is correct, rendered as a colour-coded bar.

faqs.question: How do I upload a receipt?
faqs.answer: Head to the workspace and use the Upload button. Drag and drop files or pick them from your device — JPEG, PNG and PDF are all supported.

faqs.question: What's the difference between OCR+AI and AI Vision?
faqs.answer: AI Vision analyses the receipt image directly for higher accuracy, especially with complex layouts. OCR+AI extracts text first, then structures it with AI. We recommend AI Vision for the best results.

faqs.question: How can I improve search results?
faqs.answer: Use natural language — "coffee from last week" or "groceries from Watsons over RM 50". If older receipts predate semantic search, an admin can generate their embeddings from Admin → Settings.

faqs.question: How do I manage my subscription?
faqs.answer: Open the pricing page and click "Manage subscription" — it takes you to the secure Stripe billing portal where you can change plans, view invoices and update payment methods.

faqs.question: What file formats are supported?
faqs.answer: JPEG, PNG and PDF. For the cleanest extraction, keep images sharp and well-lit with every line of text visible.

faqs.question: How accurate is the AI extraction?
faqs.answer: Accuracy is high on clear, well-lit receipts. Every field carries a confidence score so you can spot the ones worth a second look, and you can correct anything before saving.

faqs.question: Can I export my receipt data?
faqs.answer: Yes — CSV, JSON and PDF reports. Exports live on the analysis page, where you can shape the report by category or payer first.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Storage is encrypted, endpoints are secured, and access is strictly scoped. Your data is never shared with third parties.

faqs.question: What AI models do you support?
faqs.answer: Google Gemini is the default and primary engine on every plan, so processing quality doesn't depend on your subscription tier.

faqs.question: How do I set up batch processing?
faqs.answer: Batch processing is available on Pro and Max. Select multiple receipts in the workspace and run them through the batch option — the queue handles the rest.
